combined_figure6.zoom_policy: Equal x/y enlargement of exact native polygons; wall-layer thickness is not exaggerated or rescaled independently.

velocity_display.selection: One actual cell nearest each spatial-bin centre; native position and values unchanged. Every negative-u cell in the view also included. No velocity interpolation.
velocity_display.interpretation_limit: Negative global u alone does not establish wall separation or a closed recirculation region; leading-edge curved flow must be distinguished from local trailing-edge reverse flow.

wall_yplus_display.value_policy: Each exact native cell polygon uses its own exported cell value; min/max/TE values labelled; colour legend is fixed and includes actual range. No smoothing.
